name: Mass Mayhem 2
summary: Massive Mayhem 2, but this time we are making the violence righteous! You will now get to play as a war hero who will stop at nothing to destroy the evil of humanity. You can select your hero, customize his weapons and upgrade his explosive arsenal. Once again you will be able to create combo kills, unlock achievements and acquire new bonus materials. Have fun killing evil clans and destroying everything on your path. All this in the name of what is right and good!
